name: playwright-case-outcomes
goal: Record Playwright outcomes under their declared test case titles.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Playwright 1.63 reports root, project and file suites before declared describe and test titles; the adapter currently retains the filename.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing configured onTestEnd case omitted the root suite in its fixture. Extend the same registered case with the real hierarchy and both nested and top-level tests.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Capture confirmed the unchanged adapter emitted sample.test.ts > orders > ready in place of the declared orders > ready title.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Discard the Playwright root, project and file suite titles while keeping the declared nested test title.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: The unchanged method case passed at ec3631637a, paired with the failing measured test at 3f7cbe8f0a in the same environment.

steps.title: Reintroduce and restore the title defect using the existing cases.
steps.evidence: Mutant 1418ba78a1 failed capture 053abf92edd7; restored 2435e9ea8b passed with the same tree as ec3631637a.

steps.title: Measure the changed adapter and its normal recording workload.
steps.evidence: At 5d7e34832d, source bytes/lines/complexity/dependencies are 3311/99/31/3; module has no separate artifact. Capture a47d30d9c599 retains the 0.199 ms recording workload and 91406336 bytes whole-worker RSS.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
